text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**What worked:**
Reps got back about 5 hours a week. CRM updates went from "Friday scramble" to done before the next meeting. Follow-up emails went out same day, and deal handoffs stopped losing context.

**What didn't:**
Noisy sites and heavy accents hurt accuracy. A few customers hesitated when recording came up, so we learned to ask consent upfront, every time.

**The surprise:**
Managers got more value than reps. Searchable call history turned coaching from gut feel into specific examples.

**Our takeaway:**
The tool didn't replace judgment. It freed reps to listen more and type less.

Would your team try it?
